import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String inputStr = scanner.next();
        int length = inputStr.length();
        int atFound = 0;
        StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();

        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            if (i == 0 && inputStr.startsWith("at", i)) {
                output.append("at");
                i += 1;
            } else if (i == 0 && inputStr.startsWith("dot", i)) {
                output.append("dot");
                i += 3;
            } else if (i == length - 2 && inputStr.startsWith("at", i)) {
                output.append("at");
                break;
            } else if (i == length - 3 && inputStr.startsWith("dot", i)) {
                output.append("dot");
                break;
            } else if (inputStr.startsWith("at", i) && atFound == 0) {
                output.append("@");
                atFound = 1;
                i += 1;
            } else if (inputStr.startsWith("dot", i)) {
                output.append(".");
                i += 3;
            } else {
                output.append(inputStr.charAt(i));
            }
        }
        System.out.println(output.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
